# Package

The packages installed on the host. `osapi behavior get --name package` and
`osapi behavior method get` show the same.

## Method list

|             |                                                                                                                                   |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | list                                                                                                                              |
| Verb        | read                                                                                                                              |
| Description | List the packages installed on the host                                                                                           |
| Detail      | Lists each installed package with its version: dpkg on the Debian family, rpm on the other Linux families, and Homebrew on macOS. |
| HTTP        | GET                                                                                                                               |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/package                                                                                            |
| Permission  | package:read                                                                                                                      |
| Command     | [osapi client node package list](../../../usage/cli/client/node/package/list.md)                                                  |
| Input type  | ListInput                                                                                                                         |
| Output type | \[]Installed                                                                                                                      |

### Input (0)

None. The method takes no input; its command needs only --target.

### Output (6)

| FIELD        | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION                                         |
| ------------ | ------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| name         | string  | The package                                         |
| version      | string  | The installed version                               |
| architecture | string  | The architecture it is built for, such as amd64     |
| manager      | string  | The package database that has it: dpkg, rpm or brew |
| description  | string  | Its one-line summary                                |
| size         | integer | Its installed size in bytes                         |

### Examples (3)

| EXAMPLE       | INPUT  | OUTPUT                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------- | ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| A Debian host | (none) | \[architecture=amd64, description=command line tool for transferring data with URL syntax, manager=dpkg, name=curl, size=512000, version=8.5.0-2ubuntu10] |
| A Fedora host | (none) | \[architecture=x86_64, description=A utility for getting files from remote servers, manager=rpm, name=curl, size=790000, version=8.6.0-7.fc40]            |
| A Mac         | (none) | \[manager=brew, name=jq, version=1.7.1]                                                                                                                   |

## Method get

|             |                                                                                     |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | get                                                                                 |
| Verb        | read                                                                                |
| Description | Get one installed package                                                           |
| Detail      | Reads one package from the same list. A package that is not installed is not found. |
| HTTP        | GET                                                                                 |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/package/&#123;name&#125;                             |
| Permission  | package:read                                                                        |
| Command     | [osapi client node package get](../../../usage/cli/client/node/package/get.md)      |
| Input type  | GetInput                                                                            |
| Output type | Installed                                                                           |

### Input (1)

| FIELD | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                                                | DESCRIPTION               |
| ----- | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- |
| name  | string | yes      | pattern ^\[a-zA-Z0-9]\[a-zA-Z0-9.+_:~=-]*$, max length 255 | The package, such as curl |

### Output (6)

| FIELD        | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION                                         |
| ------------ | ------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| name         | string  | The package                                         |
| version      | string  | The installed version                               |
| architecture | string  | The architecture it is built for, such as amd64     |
| manager      | string  | The package database that has it: dpkg, rpm or brew |
| description  | string  | Its one-line summary                                |
| size         | integer | Its installed size in bytes                         |

### Examples (3)

| EXAMPLE              | INPUT     | OUTPUT                                                                                                                                                 |
| -------------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| An installed package | name=curl | name=curl, version=8.5.0-2ubuntu10, architecture=amd64, manager=dpkg, description=command line tool for transferring data with URL syntax, size=512000 |
| An installed formula | name=jq   | name=jq, version=1.7.1, manager=brew                                                                                                                   |
| An installed RPM     | name=curl | name=curl, version=8.6.0-7.fc40, architecture=x86_64, manager=rpm                                                                                      |

## Method create

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | create                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Description | Install a package                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Detail      | Installs the package with apt-get install, at the version when one is given. A package that is installed, at that version when one is given, does not change and reports changed: false. It runs on the Debian family only, and elsewhere reports skipped. |
| HTTP        | POST                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/package                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Permission  | package:write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Command     | [osapi client node package create](../../../usage/cli/client/node/package/create.md)                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Input type  | CreateInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Output type | Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

### Input (2)

| FIELD   | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                                                | DESCRIPTION                                                            |
| ------- | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| name    | string | yes      | pattern ^\[a-zA-Z0-9]\[a-zA-Z0-9.+_:~=-]*$, max length 255 | The package to install, such as curl                                   |
| version | string | no       | pattern ^\[0-9]\[A-Za-z0-9.+~:-]*$, max length 255         | The version to install, such as 8.5.0-2ubuntu10; the newest when empty |

### Output (2)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION              |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| name    | string  | The package              |
| changed | boolean | Whether the host changed |

### Examples (1)

| EXAMPLE           | INPUT     | OUTPUT                  |
| ----------------- | --------- | ----------------------- |
| Install a package | name=tree | name=tree, changed=true |
